{
  "test_name": "Ledger_2297_Objection1",
  "test_code": "using System.Collections.Immutable;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\nusing Xunit;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection1\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task CompositeResolver_NetStandard13Defined_OmitsExcludeFromCodeCoverageAndCompiles()\n    {\n        string source = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace TempProject\n{\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class MyObject\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int Value { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [GeneratedMessagePackResolver]\n    public partial class MyResolver\n    {\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> net80Refs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> references = net80Refs.AddRange(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack));\n\n        CSharpParseOptions parseOptions = new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)\n            .WithPreprocessorSymbols(\"NETSTANDARD1_3\");\n\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"TestAssembly\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(source, parseOptions) },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(\n            new[] { new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator() },\n            parseOptions: parseOptions);\n\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out Compilation output, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics);\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n\n        var resolverSources = runResult.Results\n            .SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources)\n            .Where(s => s.SourceText.ToString().Contains(\"FormatterCache\"))\n            .ToList();\n        Assert.NotEmpty(resolverSources);\n\n        var compileErrors = output.GetDiagnostics()\n            .Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error)\n            .ToList();\n        Assert.Empty(compileErrors);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? resolverSymbol = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"TempProject.MyResolver\");\n        Assert.NotNull(resolverSymbol);\n\n        bool hasExcludeOnResolver = resolverSymbol!.GetAttributes()\n            .Any(a => a.AttributeClass?.ToDisplayString() == \"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n        Assert.False(hasExcludeOnResolver);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? formatterCacheSymbol = resolverSymbol.GetTypeMembers(\"FormatterCache\").SingleOrDefault();\n        Assert.NotNull(formatterCacheSymbol);\n\n        bool hasExcludeOnCache = formatterCacheSymbol!.GetAttributes()\n            .Any(a => a.AttributeClass?.ToDisplayString() == \"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n        Assert.False(hasExcludeOnCache);\n    }\n}"
}
